entries.description: Make something hot over a fire.
Leave something in water for a while.
Leave something in sun or wind until the water is gone.
Rub or crush something into small pieces or powder.
Put several things together into one mass.
Hit one hard thing against another.
Cut something with a sharp edge.
Break something along its grain or layers into flat pieces.
Tie things firmly together with fibres or cord.
Weave or braid fibres into cord, mats or baskets.
Form a soft mass by hand.
Burn a shaped soft mass in strong heat until it is hard.
Heat wood with little air until it turns to charcoal.
Heat something until it becomes liquid.
